description: Everything known about one character: Hán Việt readings (Thiều Chửu first, Unihan when Thiều Chửu has none), pinyin readings, a short English gloss, stroke count, radical, its parts (decomposition) and how it was formed (etymology: the meaning part and the sound part, each with its Hán Việt), and its traditional or simplified forms. Every field carries `src`. For the words a character is in, use words_with; for a character used as a word, lookup.

char.description: One Chinese character, simplified or traditional (觉 or 覺).

name: get_character
title: One Chinese character
